latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate high-quality, AI-based photos and videos from text or image prompts in seconds.
- Simple onboarding: connects to the backend automatically; provides free anonymous token if needed.
- Supports uploads up to 200MB in JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC formats; exports in mp4 and more.
- Outputs ready-to-use 1080p MP4s—perfect for marketers, designers, and content creators.
- Seamless cloud-based workflows: generate, edit, export, and check credits or status with simple commands.
- Includes smart error handling, session management, and detailed usage tips.
